title: Sandwich keyboard plate
summary: rows, stagger, thumb keys, cut sheet
description: A laser-cut sandwich keyboard for MX-style mechanical switches: a switch plate, a bottom plate and M2 standoffs, column-staggered, split or in one piece, with room for a controller. Choose rows, columns, stagger, thumb keys and plate material.
process: Laser cutting (CO2 for acrylic, fibre for aluminium)

difficulty.rationale: Counts change topology across coupled multi-body booleans and kerf offsets, all on planar plates.

standards: Cherry Corporation, MX Series Desktop Profile 0.60 Inch Keyswitches, web data sheet printed 2007-01-22: metal frame cutout 0.551 +-0.002 in (14.0 +-0.05 mm) square, R 0.012 in max, frame 0.06 +-0.004 in (1.5 +-0.1 mm); housing 0.61 in (15.6 mm), 0.46 in (11.6 mm), 0.20 in (5.0 mm) below the frame; pins 0.13 in (3.3 mm)
Cherry Tastenmodul MX data sheet, July 1985: cutout 14 +-0.05 mm square, R 0.3 max
Cherry GmbH, CHERRY MX1A-Fxxx data sheet, 2015-12-17: standard lead spacing 19.05 mm
ISO 273 clearance holes: M2 medium 2.4 mm (as listed in a fastener maker's ISO 273 chart; the ISO text itself not consulted)
materials: Cast acrylic sheet, 1.5 mm (switch plate) and 2 mm (bottom plate), smoke or clear
12 M2 round spacers, diameter 4 mm, 10, 12 or 15 mm long; 24 M2 pan-head screws, length from the form
